duties.title: Planning Phase
duties.description: In this phase, players discuss and strategize their moves. They can share information, make alliances, or deceive others to gain an advantage.

duties.title: Action Phase
duties.description: Players execute their planned actions. This could involve moving to different locations, attacking other players, or using special abilities.

duties.title: Resolution Phase
duties.description: The outcomes of the actions taken in the Action Phase are determined. Players may gain rewards, suffer consequences, or trigger events based on their actions.
